state.request: Enhance Empirical initialization and global agent installation UX. When the empirical-init skill initializes or repairs a repository, present a polished settings wizard before persisting configuration. The wizard must expose evidence policy (required criterion evidence, real-browser checks for UI criteria, UI screenshots, and code review), Git/worktree isolation (mode, base branch, sibling path, and branch pattern), Complex decision records, and any other currently configurable safety settings that belong in setup, while keeping internal Fast/Complex routing hidden. Use safe recommended defaults, explain dependencies between toggles, allow review/edit before confirmation, preserve existing settings during repair, and retain equivalent non-interactive MCP/private-CLI inputs. Replace the current five-row empirical install picker with a searchable, scrollable, polished terminal selector modeled on the current vercel-labs/skills npx CLI experience. Expand global skill-install targets from five agents to the broad audited agent catalog supported by the npx skills ecosystem, including names, ids, native global skill roots, detection hints, and remembered/currently-managed selection. Show detected, installed, and destination-path status; preserve exact --agent, --all, --yes, --json reconciliation and marker/path safety. Keep broad skill-install compatibility separate from executable handoff/MCP capabilities so Empirical never claims it can launch or configure a runtime that only accepts skill files. First produce a reviewable specification and an accurate terminal/conversation mockup; do not implement until the user approves.

evidence.summary: CLI setup tests and a real TTY cancellation run proved the full summary/Apply-Customize-Cancel gate occurs before .empirical writes and creates no feature state.
Setup, CLI, core, and MCP tests persisted all four evidence booleans with all-on first-run defaults.
Setup rendering and interactive CLI tests covered isolation, resolved/base display, worktree/branch templates, and Complex decisions without profile or repair-limit prompts.
Core and setup tests proved criterion-off leaves UI values stored/inactive while independent review remains required.
Interactive CLI and setup validation tests covered section-by-section customization, effective Save/Edit/Cancel review, invalid templates, and mutation-free cancellation.
Repair tests showed current/Keep presentation, unedited value preservation, and cancellation before integration/context repair.
Typecheck plus core, private CLI, JSON, and stdio MCP tests passed for partial evidence/isolation/decision inputs and omitted-value preservation.
Pure 40/80/120-column selector tests and real TTY search/select/Escape sessions verified bounded scrolling, statuses, paths, keys, cursor restoration, and cancellation.
Catalog tests and a direct comparison to pinned upstream commit 7cb7db64 verified identical 75-id order/paths, 73 global targets, provenance, safe paths, exclusions, and offline runtime.
Selector and integration tests covered remembered/detected priority, name/id/alias/path search, broad --yes reuse, and empty-selection refusal.
Temporary-home integration tests passed for 65 unique roots, shared-root reference retention/removal, convergence, unmanaged files/directories, and symlink protection.
CLI integration tests passed for repeatable --agent/-a, --all, --yes/-y, --json, legacy aliases, canonical reports, empty yes errors, and repeated convergence.
Catalog and handoff tests proved skill-only CodeBuddy/Cline entries have no MCP/handoff claim and never broaden the five-entry executable handoff registry.
Human/JSON report tests and bundled smoke verified canonical selected agents, 65 destinations, five skill names, outcomes, verified guidance for five runtimes, and honest unknown guidance.
Documentation/generated-skill assertions, public help boundary tests, package dry-run, and bundled smoke all passed.
